title: Test :4 DSSSB TGT Computer Science - 24 June 2023 (Shift 2)

questions.q: Six friends, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting around a round table facing toward the centre and equidistant from each other. A is sitting second to the left of C. D is sitting opposite to B. F is sitting to the immediate right of B. Who is sitting second to the right of E?
In a row of 50 students, Rahul is at the 15th position to the left of Ravi, who is at the 20th position from right end. What will be the position of Rahul from the left end?

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:
A. All ducks are cats.
B. All cats are lions.
C. Some lions are jungles.

Conclusions:
I. No lions are cats.
II. No cat is a duck.
III. All ducks are lions.
options: Only conclusions II and III follow
All the conclusions, I, II and III, follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

questions.q: There are six persons, P, Q, R, S, T and U. T is older than P and R. U is younger than Q. T is younger than S. R is older than Q but younger than P. Who is the second youngest of all?

Select the letter-cluster from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

HXK, MUC, ?, WOP, BLK
If a man reaches the 15th letter from beginning and the 14th letter from the end in the English alphabet, what would be the letter exactly between these two letters?

Study the following (English alphabetical) series and answer the question that follows.

ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ

If the 2nd, 5th, 12th, 13th, 15th, 16th and 18th letters from the series are chosen to form a meaningful word, which letter will come in the middle of that word? Each letter must be used and only once.

In the morning, from Point A, a man started walking 10 m towards the direction of the Sun, and then took a right turn and walked 10 m. Again, he took a right turn and walked 10 m, and then took another turn in the left direction and walked 10 m. After this, he walked 20 m towards the direction of the Sun, and finally walked 20 m towards the north direction. In what direction and at what distance is he now from his initial point?
In a family, there are 3 fathers, 3 mothers, 3 daughters, 3 sons, 2 nieces, 2 nephews, 1 son-in-law and 1 daughter-in-law. How many minimum members are there in the family?

A question is given, followed by two statements labelled I and II. Identify which of the statements is/are sufficient/necessary to answer the question.

Question: How is Mahesh related to Bipin?

Statements:
I. Mahesh is the son of Devika.
II. Devika is the only daughter of Bipin's father.
options: Statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question, while statement II alone is not sufficient to answer the question
Statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question, while statement I alone is not sufficient to answer the question
Either statement I alone or statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question
Both statements I and II are necessary to answer the question
